constraints.monitor_scope: Repository tracked and non-ignored files are hash-monitored per phase; the Antigravity sandbox is required for process isolation. This is a guardrail, not an operating-system security boundary.

phases.objective: Normalize the user request into one bounded objective, explicit acceptance criteria, exclusions, and unresolved blockers.
Find only the public contracts, files, symbols, or document context needed for the accepted objective and record evidence without editing.
Inspect only the public contracts needed for one root-cause change or black-box test slice, then declare its exact write allowlist, focused check, and stopping condition.
Apply only the approved root-cause change inside the declared allowlist and preserve unrelated behavior.
Run only the focused test or black-box scenario declared by the plan and preserve exact command, output, and artifact evidence.

Through public WordAssistant commands only, create verified-source evidence and one scaffold, write one UTF-8 content JSON containing 20000-26000 visible characters, then run wordassistant compose once to produce one substantive DOCX with real Heading 2/3 and evidence-linked citations; never generate or run helper code.

Through public WordAssistant commands only, apply one bounded atomic plan plus only necessary native operations to publish one final DOCX with body-scoped multilevel numbering, landscape content, TOC/LOF/LOT/PAGE/SEQ/REF/PAGEREF, bookmarks, and image alt/title; never generate or run helper code and create no throwaway DOCX.

Through public WordAssistant commands, validate the feature-complete DOCX, update fields to one distinct final-native DOCX, rerun exact-profile integrity audit on that final hash, bind provenance, and render exactly 18-25 pages once; first-pass verify exit code 1 is expected when it truthfully reports REVIEW_REQUIRED; do not inspect page images or attest visual review in this phase.

Inspect the visible content of every immutable page image from the final-native render, reject blank/clipped/duplicated/malformed pages, then use the hash-bound review token to complete the public WordAssistant delivery gate without changing the DOCX.
Run the predeclared public-CLI negative cases against disposable copies, compare each exact expected invariant with the observed failure, and leave the verified final evidence unchanged.
Audit the request, exclusions, write allowlist, Git delta, evidence, and unsupported claims; fail on any contradiction or scope expansion.
Independently review public contracts, routing, compatibility, transactions, and change impact using evidence rather than prior conclusions.
Independently review real Word semantics, fields, numbering, sections, pagination, reopen behavior, and every rendered page relevant to the request.
Independently review failure paths, test validity, capability truth, packaging, release evidence, and security boundaries.
Reconcile only observed evidence and independent findings into PASS, FAIL, or INCOMPLETE without editing or silently waiving a failed gate.
